integrity: The exact 44-facet presentation is replayed independently. All 220 vertex triples are checked by exact mod-two chain reduction; the full automorphism group is exhaustively recovered from all link-cycle-compatible permutations and its action on every triangular homology class is computed.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only length-three mod-two homology representatives in the exact genus-six surface number 58; it does not give the complete simple-cycle spectrum, integral classes, or results for the other 58 neighborly genus-six surfaces. The 1996 primary publication was month-resolved in the inspected evidence, so the machine date uses the earliest later day-resolved source rather than inventing a 1996 day.
title: Every empty triangle is a nonseparating systole in the twelve-vertex genus-six surface
